words.definition: the loud noise that comes after lightning during a storm.

words.definition: a thing you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain.
words.example: Take your umbrella, it might rain.

text: Last weekend, the weather changed very quickly in our town. On Saturday morning, the sky was clear and sunny, so my family decided to go for a walk by the lake. The sun felt warm on our faces, and the temperature was about twenty-five degrees. But in the afternoon, dark clouds appeared and the sky became very cloudy. The forecast on the radio said a storm was coming, so we hurried home. Soon the wind grew strong and it became windy outside. We heard thunder in the distance, and then the rain started. It was a very rainy evening! We stayed inside, warm and dry, and watched from the window. My little brother was worried because the streets began to fill with water, almost like a flood. Luckily, the storm didn't last long. By Sunday, the air felt cool and fresh, and the sky was blue again. When we went out, I remembered to take an umbrella just in case, but we didn't need it. The cold weather at night reminded us that autumn was coming soon.
